mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN expense_type = 'FIXED' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0 ) AS fixed_expense_total, COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN expense_type = 'VARIABLE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0 ) AS variable_expense_total, COALESCE( SUM(amount), 0 ) AS total_expense FROM expense_transactions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND transaction_date >= #{startDate} AND transaction_date < #{endDate}

SELECT ec.category_id AS category_id, ec.category_name AS name, SUM(et.amount) AS amount FROM expense_transactions et INNER JOIN expense_categories ec ON et.category_id = ec.category_id WHERE et.user_id = #{userId} AND et.transaction_date >= #{startDate} AND et.transaction_date < #{endDate} GROUP BY ec.category_id, ec.category_name ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT pm.payment_method_id AS payment_method_id, pm.payment_method_name AS name, SUM(et.amount) AS amount FROM expense_transactions et INNER JOIN payment_methods pm ON et.payment_method_id = pm.payment_method_id WHERE et.user_id = #{userId} AND et.transaction_date >= #{startDate} AND et.transaction_date < #{endDate} GROUP BY pm.payment_method_id, pm.payment_method_name ORDER BY amount DESC
